meta.method: walk-london-datastore.mjs harvest census2021-lsoa-labour-market: 6 resources (xlsx); a row is kept when a cell holds a zone code of type lsoa21 (feeds/london-datastore/zone-codes.json: areas that meet the 3D model box or hold a zone postcode). Sheets: the up to 3 rows above the first coded row are kept as header_rows. CSV: streamed; the first line is the header; a row is kept by its first E00/E01/E02/E05 code.
